nuggets.text: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak ran the offense for the Seahawks team that won Super Bowl LX in February.
Klint Kubiak's father, Gary Kubiak, won Super Bowl 50 as head coach of the Denver Broncos.
Fernando Mendoza, the Raiders' No. 1 overall pick, is the first Heisman Trophy winner in Indiana history.
Fernando Mendoza wears No. 15, the number of Raiders legend Tom Flores, and got Flores's blessing to wear it.
Kirk Cousins, the Raiders' opening-day starter, turned 'You like that!' into a catchphrase after a 2015 comeback win.
Kirk Cousins and Raiders coach Klint Kubiak worked together in Minnesota before reuniting in Las Vegas.
Tom Brady is part of the Raiders' ownership group, sharing a stake with business partner Tom Wagner.
The Raiders were nearly the Oakland Senors, switching to Raiders nine days later after the name drew local jokes.
The Al Davis Memorial Torch at Allegiant Stadium stands 85 feet tall and was called the world's largest 3D-printed object in 2019.
Ashton Jeanty ran for 100-plus yards in all 14 of Boise State's games in 2024, piling up 2,601 yards.
